text:
Version 2.4 is out.

We fixed 12 crashes, so the app should be more stable and you'll see fewer unexpected interruptions.

Startup is faster too. The app used to take 3.4 seconds to launch, and now it takes 1.9 seconds.

The biggest addition is Offline Mode. You can keep browsing, creating and working when your connection drops, with no Wi-Fi needed.

One change to note: Version 2.4 no longer supports Android 8. Dropping it lets us put more effort into new features and performance on newer devices. If you're still on Android 8, you'll need to upgrade your OS or device to get this release.

Thanks for using the app. You can update now.
